title: InfiniteHits Load More button translation
body:
Hello, it seems like there is no way to change text in Load More button for InfiniteHits component?

There is no Translation Keys in [docs](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/widgets/InfiniteHits.html)

And I checked source code, it seems like `Load More` is hardcoded

comments.body: Thanks a lot for your report! This can be fixed quite fast. Do you want to do a pull request?
@Haroenv sorry, I'm not familiar with your project codebase :(
No problem, we will get it fixed!
